Some features of the game Blox Fruits are:

1. Fruit System: Players can obtain various fruit powers by finding and consuming Devil Fruits scattered throughout the map. Each fruit gives different abilities and movesets.

2. Quests: Players can embark on quests to earn rewards and level up their characters. Quests include defeating enemies, finding treasure, and exploring hidden areas.

5. Ships and Sea Exploration: Players can obtain and upgrade their own ships to explore the vast seas. They can discover new islands, fight sea monsters, and uncover hidden treasures.

6. Boss Battles: Players can team up with friends or other players to take on challenging boss battles. Defeating bosses rewards players with valuable treasure and rare items.

7. Trading System: Players can trade their items, fruits, and currencies with other players to complete their collections or acquire desired items.

8. Customization: Players can customize their characters with different outfits, accessories, and skins. This allows players to show off their unique style and identity in the game.

9. World Events: The game occasionally includes special world events where players can participate in limited-time activities, gain exclusive rewards, and experience unique gameplay challenges.

10. Regular Updates: The game receives regular updates, introducing new fruits, areas, quests, and features to keep the gameplay fresh and exciting for players.
